meta.title: ReturnReady Utah — combined workforce re-entry resource directory
display_rules: Show only records with show_in_demo = true in the live app.
featured_for_demo = true marks ChatGPT's 19-item demo seed (plus merged duplicates).
Use status + action_label together. Never label a card 'Open now' unless a teammate confirmed a live opening today.
url_verified = false means the link or program was not confirmed; hide it or show 'Status unknown'.
Descriptions are paraphrases, not eligibility decisions or endorsements. Let people browse without saying why they were out of work.

statuses.ongoing: Standing service or directory. Local intake, openings, and eligibility can change.
statuses.check_provider: The provider advertises the program or route. Confirm current intake, dates, geography, and work style.
statuses.cohort_listed: The provider lists upcoming dates. Confirm that the application route remains open.
statuses.interest_list: The source offers an interest or talent registration. Check for a separate open requisition.
statuses.no_opening_seen: The retrieved postings page showed no openings. Recheck the live board before relying on this snapshot.
statuses.local_returnship_unverified: General employer careers page. A Utah returnship has not been verified.
statuses.historical_only: Historical reference for maintainers. Exclude from search results for current opportunities.

meta.note: Demo subset: featured_for_demo = true. Same schema as returnready_resources.json.

resources.name: ARUP Laboratories Returnships
resources.description: Paid short-term returnship at ARUP in Salt Lake City for skilled people with at least a one-year employment gap, or who have been on active military duty. Tracks include technical (IT and lab work), business, and operations, with mentorship. The careers page invites applicants to browse open returnship jobs or submit a Returnship Interest Form if no current posting fits.
resources.next_step: Use ARUP's interest form or its linked returnship board. The employer confirms the program and both routes. Individual job availability was not verified.
flexibility: paid short-term returnship; tracks in technical, business, and operations
resources.notes: Program page is live as of 2026-11-14 and describes ongoing applications via the job board or interest form. Individual openings can change; confirm a current posting before presenting a role as open. A March 2024 news URL should not be used as the apply link. | Source is a 2024 news post; confirm the program is still open.

resources.name: Goldman Sachs Returnship
resources.geography: Salt Lake City and other listed cities
resources.location: Multiple U.S. cities including Salt Lake City, UT; also other global locations
resources.description: Paid 12-week returnship for experienced professionals who have been out of full-time work for two or more years and have at least three years of prior work experience. The official page lists Salt Lake City, UT among Americas locations (availability varies by division). The Americas cohort is described as January–March 2027; the page says to register to receive an invitation when applications open.
resources.next_step: The Americas cohort is listed for January–March 2027. Salt Lake City is named, subject to division availability. Paid 12-week full-time commitment. Follow the interest link and confirm posting status.
resources.notes: As of 2026-11-14, the page does not state that Americas applications are currently open; it asks candidates to register for an invitation. Full-time 12-week commitment. Do not describe it as an open cohort until the application is actually open. | Confirm current cohort.
